page.overview:
Who is Greenshirt?

Greenshirts are members of the G.I. Joe Team who support the main team in any way they can.

There was never any acknowledgement in the plot of extra, unnamed Joes in the comic. Certainly not an army of them like in the cartoon. Nevertheless, generic-looking troopers in green uniforms that cannot be identified with any named G.I. Joe made infrequent appearances as background characters. This may be an issue with the artwork more than anything else.

Several Greenshirts supported Stalker and Breaker during a raid on Cobra safehouse in Nebraska.

Greenshirts were part of a team that was tricked into attacking an oil rig belonging to Destro, but was subsequently freed by Quick Kick. They later fought in the battle to defend Action Force's London base when Cobra attacked to free Destro.
